note: Boss taunt VO. Generated via ElevenLabs into src/assets/sounds/voice/boss/<boss>_<category>_<i>.mp3. Three distinct CUSTOM antagonist voices (owned by the ELEVENLABS_API workspace — the legacy ELEVENLABS_API_KEY workspace canNOT see them). boss_voice_system.gd plays them at +10 dB; boss_voice_data.gd mirrors the per-category counts for the runtime random-picker. Keep COUNTS in boss_voice_data.gd in sync with the line counts here.

tax.voice_note: Custom 'IRS Auditor' — nasal, bureaucratic, condescending. Stage 1 Tax Collector / Auditor.

intro: Lil Blunt! Your gains are MY gains!
Step aside — this is a lawful seizure!
taunt: I'm auditing your soul, green boy!
Tax Form 420 says you owe... everything!
F-O-M-O won't save you from the I-R-S!
Your deductions are DENIED, nugget!
Every puff is a taxable event!
I've got a subpoena with your name on it!
Late fees compound, little sprout!
Report to Window Four for processing!
mock: That's a penalty for late payment!
hurt: Ow! That's assault on a federal agent!
I'll add that to your bill!
phase50: Fine! We are escalating to a full audit!
phase25: This is highway robbery! MY robbery!
death: I'll see you... in tax court...
Appealing this... to a higher office...

crystal.voice_note: Custom 'Crystal Distributor' — cold, robotic, corporate-flat. Stage 2 liquidation/buyback antagonist.

taunt: Liquidating your health. Please hold.
Resistance is inefficient. Comply.
Diamond hands? I prefer diamond bones.
Your equity has been... redistributed.
Hold still. This is a mandatory buyback.
I hoard. You bleed. Efficient.
Your rewards pool is now my pool.
Downtrend detected. That's you.
mock: Marked down, and marked for deletion.
hurt: Error. You were not... priced in.
phase50: Q3 earnings are... your whole stack.

bandit.voice_note: Custom 'Bandit' — gravelly, wild-west, unhinged. Stage 3 Claim Jumper.

intro: This here claim's MINE, ya sprout!
taunt: I'm gonna blast you back to seed!
This minecart's got your name on it!
Fort Knox? More like Fort Knocked Out!
Hand over the gold, ya little weed!
I jumped better claims than yours!
Say howdy to my dynamite, partner!
Yer nuggets belong to ME now!
Ain't no sheriff comin' to save ya!
mock: Back to the dirt where ya came from!
hurt: Ya dented my hat, ya varmint!
phase50: Now I'm angry! Off the rails we go!
Time to light the WHOLE fuse!
phase25: Mega bomb time! Tick, tick, tick!
I'll bury us both, ya hear?!
death: Ya blew it all up... good for you... greenhorn...
My gold... my claim... my... hat...
